# hkg_data_model fixtures

Copied from `examples/*.min.example.json` in
https://codebase.helmholtz.cloud/hmc/helmholtz-kg/semantics/internal-data-model
at tag **1.1.0** — the same tag the backend pins in `backend/pyproject.toml`
(card F6). Upstream validates these examples against both the JSON schema and
the pydantic models in its own test suite.
